errors.evidence: The description incorrectly transcribes the category label 'друго (посочете какво)' as 'грузо (посочете какво)'. This error appears twice.
The description incorrectly transcribes the category label 'Вид (например списание)' as 'Bug (например списание)'.
The list of categories on the vertical axis is incomplete; it omits the category 'eISBN'.
The description uses the word 'Височината' (height) to describe the horizontal bars, when 'дължината' (length) would be the correct term.
The description fails to mention that another category, 'година' (year), shares the same maximum value of approximately 9.

The description incorrectly identifies 'url:' as the category with the lowest value. In the chart, the lowest values (approx. 1) belong to 'eISBN', 'ISBN', and one of the 'друго...' categories, while 'url:' has a value of approximately 3.

The description states that the lowest bar ('url:') has a value of approximately 1. This is incorrect. The value for 'url:' is approximately 3, and the actual lowest value in the chart is 1, which corresponds to other categories ('eISBN', 'ISBN', and 'друго...').
